request.expression:
do
  if (readAll(upsDemoPilot).size != 0) throw "Pilot exists; reconcile first"
  if (readAll(point and upsDemo and equipRef==@p:mytest:r:323a8133-b4e7ddac and (upsLogicalField=="loadPct" or upsLogicalField=="batterySocPct" or upsLogicalField=="runtimeEstimateMinutes")).size != 3) throw "Expected exactly three pilot points"
  commit(diff(null, {floor, floorNum:1, navName:"UPS机房", dis:"UPS站点A 机房", siteRef:read(upsDemoKey=="site-a")->id, upsDemo, upsDemoFloor, upsDemoKey:"floor-a", demoBatch:"upsDemo20260914"}, {add}))
  sitea: read(upsDemoKey=="site-a")->id
  floora: read(upsDemoKey=="floor-a")->id
  readAll(upsDemo and (equip or point) and siteRef==sitea).each(r => diff(r, {floorRef:floora}).commit)
  commit(diff(null, {floor, floorNum:1, navName:"UPS机房", dis:"UPS站点B 机房", siteRef:read(upsDemoKey=="site-b")->id, upsDemo, upsDemoFloor, upsDemoKey:"floor-b", demoBatch:"upsDemo20260914"}, {add}))
  siteb: read(upsDemoKey=="site-b")->id
  floorb: read(upsDemoKey=="floor-b")->id
  readAll(upsDemo and (equip or point) and siteRef==siteb).each(r => diff(r, {floorRef:floorb}).commit)
  do
  ts: now()
  readAll(point and upsDemo and equipRef==@p:mytest:r:323a8133-b4e7ddac and (upsLogicalField=="loadPct" or upsLogicalField=="batterySocPct" or upsLogicalField=="runtimeEstimateMinutes")).each(p => do
    fraction: ts.time.second.as(1) / 30 - 1
    diff(p, {curVal:p->upsBase + p->upsAmplitude * fraction, curStatus:"ok", upsSourceTs:ts, upsLastGoodAt:ts}, {transient}).commit
  end)
  "pilot-current-updated"
end
  cutoff: now()
  readAll(point and upsDemo and equipRef==@p:mytest:r:323a8133-b4e7ddac and (upsLogicalField=="loadPct" or upsLogicalField=="batterySocPct" or upsLogicalField=="runtimeEstimateMinutes")).each(p => do
    samples: (0..287).map(i => do
      ts: cutoff - 1day + (i+1)*5min
      {ts:ts, val:upsDemoValue20260914(p, ts)}
    end)
    samples.hisWrite(p)
    diff(readById(p->id), {hisCollectInterval:5min}).commit
  end)
  commit(diff(null, {job, upsDemoPilot, upsDemo, demoBatch:"upsDemo20260914", dis:"UPS 原生界面三点验证", jobExpr:"do\n  ts: now()\n  readAll(point and upsDemo and equipRef==@p:mytest:r:323a8133-b4e7ddac and (upsLogicalField==\"loadPct\" or upsLogicalField==\"batterySocPct\" or upsLogicalField==\"runtimeEstimateMinutes\")).each(p => do\n    fraction: ts.time.second.as(1) / 30 - 1\n    diff(p, {curVal:p->upsBase + p->upsAmplitude * fraction, curStatus:\"ok\", upsSourceTs:ts, upsLastGoodAt:ts}, {transient}).commit\n  end)\n  \"pilot-current-updated\"\nend", jobSchedule:"every 10sec"}, {add}))
  {floorsAdded:2, pilotPoints:3, historySamples:864}
end
